title: Volunteering at the library
instructions: Emre kütüphanede gönüllü olarak ne yaptığını anlatıyor. Gün ve görevlerine dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Every Saturday morning, I volunteer at our local library.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I help children choose books, and I read stories to them.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I also put the returned books back on the shelves.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I don't get any money, but I really enjoy it.

script.speaker: s
script.text: It's also good practice, because I want to be a teacher.

questions.prompt: What does he do for the children?
Why is it good practice for Emre?
options: He wants to be a librarian.
He wants to be a writer.
He wants to be a teacher.
He wants to work with books.
questions.evidence: because I want to be a teacher.
